headword: {市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}

definitions.gloss: market launch; market introduction; bringing to market
definitions.explanation: The act of introducing a new product or service into the marketplace. A standard business term used in product development, marketing, and corporate communications.

examples.japanese: {新製品|しんせいひん}の{市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}は{来年|らいねん}の{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: The market launch of the new product is planned for next year.

examples.japanese: {競合他社|きょうごうたしゃ}より{早|はや}く{市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}することが{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: It is important to bring it to market faster than the competitors.

examples.japanese: {開発|かいはつ}から{市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}までの{期間|きかん}を{短縮|たんしゅく}するために、{新|あたら}しい{生産|せいさん}ラインを{導入|どうにゅう}した。
examples.english: To shorten the time from development to market launch, a new production line was introduced.

notes:
A compound of {市場|しじょう} (market) and {投入|とうにゅう} (putting in, investment). Commonly used in business news, press releases, and corporate strategy discussions. Can also be used as a verb with する.

Note that {市場|しじょう} in this context is read しじょう (market in the business/economic sense), not いちば (physical marketplace).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}する: to launch on the market
- {市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}の{時期|じき}: timing of the market launch
- {市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}を{急|いそ}ぐ: to rush the market launch
- {市場投入|しじょうとうにゅう}{後|ご}: after market introduction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {発売|はつばい}: release, going on sale — more commonly used for consumer products
- {上市|じょうし}: market listing, launch — more formal, used in pharmaceutical and financial contexts
- {商品化|しょうひんか}: commercialization — the broader process of turning something into a product
